title: In This Town Your Stuff Decides What OPENS For You
description:
In this town, a door won't open unless something of yours is inside. Jo's front door stopped lighting up for me after we split. One door still opens for both of us: unit seven, in a storage block on the edge of town, full of boxes she never came back for.

Every Tuesday at seven I sit in there for an hour. The corridor lights run on a one-minute timer. The first week, somebody was standing in the open doorway of unit eleven. From the front they looked ordinary. Each Tuesday after that, they were one door nearer mine.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Would you have kept both keys on your ring after the split?
